summary: Campaign is honestly incomplete against whole-component targets. Saved metrics largely match independent Jacoco/Istanbul recomputation; gate correctly fails. Server/browser meet line/branch floors but not CRAP≤8. Android remains far below coverage/CRAP with 605 unmapped functions. No evidence of marking unmapped functions covered or substituting line% for branch%. Concrete defect: GateScreen PAUSED copy changed while androidTest still asserts the old headline. Mutation evidence supports scoped kills plus one documented equivalent accounting survivor; ordinary tests were rerun with source hashes unchanged. Not ready to call targets met; suitable for user manual checks of the changed GPS/accounting/agent/browser areas, after fixing the stale GateScreenTest expectation.

From quality/metrics/android-functions.json joins: V1GpsService mapped avg coverage 0 with onLocationChanged CRAP 240; GateScreen avg 0; Chrome accessibility / enforcement paths remain in remaining-scope largest gaps (SprintChallengeActivity, DashboardScreen, ChromeAccessibilityService, GateScreen, SprintLocationService, V1Coordinator, overlays). Full-coverage high-CC functions still have CRAP=complexity (e.g. store anonymous@90:165 CC/CRAP 18; expandChanges 16). Hotspots remain server.mjs request router CC48, agent chat CC40, voice.mjs event CRAP≈63.6, browser app.js review renderer CRAP≈26. No CRAP waivers recorded (gate.exceptions []).

SEVERITY MEDIUM — Pre-existing/unfixed WAITING androidTest expectation also mismatches production. GateScreenTest waiting case expects "UNLOCKING BROWSER" while GateScreen WAITING headline has been "Hang on a moment." since checkpoint 11af973 (uppercase → "HANG ON A MOMENT."). Assignment asked to inspect/fix stale screen expectations; this was left for user.

SEVERITY LOW — Live GPS timing basis changed with tracker extraction. V1GpsService now feeds GpsDistanceTracker with location.time (wall clock), matching backend-v1/evidence.mjs verifyGps; prior inline logic used elapsedRealtimeNanos. Likely intentional parity; still a user-visible verification risk if wall clock jumps. Tracker bands/noise/gap thresholds align with evidence.mjs (walk/sprint).
